arabic text: mun dhamp ke rone lagi ahmed ki nawaasi,, viraan taro baam\nthe allah re udasi, ujra bani hashim ka Mehella nazar aaya
english translation text: When Kulsum raised the curtain of the litter, Ahmed's granddaughter covered her face and wept; the rooftops and streets\nwere deserted—what loneliness! The ruined quarter of Bani Hashim appeared before her

arabic text: Wo galiya jaha awno muhammad kabhi khele, Abdulla wahaa\nphirte the khamosh akele, har simt me bacho ka sarapa\nnazar aaya
english translation text: Those streets where Aun and Muhammad once\nplayed—Abdullah now wandered there alone in silence; the\nforms of the children everywhere appeared before him

arabic text: Sugra ne khabar payi ke lawt aaye musafir, Khush hogayi roze\npe nabi ke koyi hazir Kya socha tha sugra ne use kya nazar\naaya
english translation text: Sughra heard that the travellers had returned; she\nbecame joyful and hurried to the Prophet's shrine. What\nSughra had imagined, and what she actually saw

arabic text: ujri huwi har maang ti har god thi khali, asger ka shalo ka tha\nsakina ki thi baali, abbas ka parcham bhi akela nazar aaya
english translation text: Every parting was ruined, every lap was empty; there was Asghar's shawl\nand Sakina's earring; even Abbas's standard appeared alone

arabic text: Jis waqt ruki nana ke roze pe amaari, Na khese giri khak pe\nwo dard ki maari,\nrota huwa nana ka jo chehra nazar aaya
english translation text: When the litter stopped at her grandfather's shrine,\nthe grief-stricken lady fell from the camel onto the\ndust; her grandfather's weeping face appeared before her

arabic text: sugra ne kaha amaa se kyu god hai khali, kis aaha bhari banu\nne kuch moo se na boli, rone lagi jalta huwa jula nazar aaya
english translation text: Sughra asked her mother why her lap was empty; the sighing Bano\ncould not utter a word. She began to weep when the burned cradle appeared

arabic text: Bin bhayi ke dakhil huwi jo apne hi gar me, Gash aagaya takat\nna rahi kalbo jigar mein, be goro kafan bhayi ka laasha\nnazar aaya
english translation text: When she entered her own home without her\nbrother, she fainted; no strength remained in heart or body.\nHer brother's unburied, unshrouded body appeared before her

arabic text: hujre me nazar aaye nahi qasimo akber,kehne lagi mein chor\ngayi thi ye bhara gar, har kabr ke mahol mein, dhalta nazar\naaya
english translation text: Qasim and Akbar were nowhere to be seen in\nthe rooms; she said, I had left this home full.\nWithin every grave-like room the evening seemed to descend

arabic text: Bistar to waha awno muhammad ke saje the,Aur taak mein\nasgher ke khilone bhi rakhe the, lekin na koyi khelne,waala\nnazar aaya
english translation text: The beds of Aun and Muhammad were\nstill laid out, and Asghar's toys remained upon\nthe shelf; but no child remained to play
